operative_clauses.original_operative_text: I, JIMMY CARTER, President of the United States, find that the situation in Iran constitutes an unusual and extraordinary threat to the national security, foreign policy and economy of the United States and hereby declare a national emergency to deal with that threat.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); unnumbered paragraph 1

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: I hereby order blocked all property and interests in property of the Government of Iran, its instrumentalities and controlled entities and the Central Bank of Iran which are or become subject to the jurisdiction of the United States or which are in or come within the possession or control of persons subject to the jurisdiction of the United States.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); unnumbered paragraph 2

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: The Secretary of the Treasury is authorized to employ all powers granted to me by the International Emergency Economic Powers Act to carry out the provisions of this order.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); unnumbered paragraph 3

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: This order is effective immediately and shall be transmitted to the Congress and published in the FEDERAL REGISTER.
